list.name: contributor
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(contributor, ''), '(unattributed)') AS __text, COALESCE(NULLIF(contributor, ''), '') AS __value FROM whodunit_repos ORDER BY 1
list.label: Contributor

list.name: team
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(t.name, ''), '(unassigned)') AS __text, COALESCE(NULLIF(t.name, ''), '(unassigned)') AS __value FROM whodunit_repos r LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = r.contributor LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id ORDER BY 1
list.label: Team

options.content:
Which integrations the team has actually picked up, how deeply, and who has not

An MCP server is an integration the agent can call — an issue tracker, a browser, a design tool. Every call is recorded with the server and tool name, never its content. This page reads breadth (how many people use each one) separately from depth (how hard the people who use it lean on it), because a server with two heavy users and one with nine light ones look identical as a call count.

panels.title: Calls per server, per week
panels.description: Every MCP server as a row, weeks across, colour by call volume. The pattern to read is horizontal: a row that brightens is an integration being picked up, one that fades is being abandoned. A row that appears late is a new integration.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN e.mcp_server IS NULL OR e.mcp_server = '' THEN '' ELSE LOWER(TRIM(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.mcp_server,'^(mcp__codex_apps__|plugin:[^:]+:|claude\\.ai |claude_ai_|mcp__)',''),'-server',''))) END AS server,
         e.tool, e.session, COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) AS person,
         COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') AS team, e.observed_at, DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1e9)) DAY) AS w
  FROM whodunit_events e LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = e.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND e.tool <> '' AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}'))
SELECT CAST(w AS DATETIME) AS time, server AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value
FROM c WHERE server <> '' GROUP BY w, server ORDER BY time, server

panels.title: Servers by calls
panels.description: MCP servers ranked by calls in range. Volume alone — see the breadth-and-depth row for who is behind it.

WITH c AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN e.mcp_server IS NULL OR e.mcp_server = '' THEN '' ELSE LOWER(TRIM(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.mcp_server,'^(mcp__codex_apps__|plugin:[^:]+:|claude\\.ai |claude_ai_|mcp__)',''),'-server',''))) END AS server,
         e.tool, e.session, COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) AS person,
         COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') AS team, e.observed_at, DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1e9)) DAY) AS w
  FROM whodunit_events e LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = e.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND e.tool <> '' AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}'))
SELECT server AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM c WHERE server <> '' GROUP BY server ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: MCP share of tool calls
panels.description: Share of all agent tool calls that went to an integration rather than a built-in tool. The headline for whether integrations are part of how people work here, or an occasional reach.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN e.mcp_server IS NULL OR e.mcp_server = '' THEN '' ELSE LOWER(TRIM(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.mcp_server,'^(mcp__codex_apps__|plugin:[^:]+:|claude\\.ai |claude_ai_|mcp__)',''),'-server',''))) END AS server,
         e.tool, e.session, COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) AS person,
         COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') AS team, e.observed_at, DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1e9)) DAY) AS w
  FROM whodunit_events e LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = e.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND e.tool <> '' AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}'))
SELECT ROUND(100*SUM(server <> '')/COUNT(*),1) AS value FROM c

panels.title: People using it, against calls per person
panels.description: One dot per server. Across: how many people used it at all. Up: how many calls each of those people made. Top-right is embedded in how the team works; bottom-right is widely tried and lightly used; top-left is a power tool for a few. Each corner is a different rollout decision.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN e.mcp_server IS NULL OR e.mcp_server = '' THEN '' ELSE LOWER(TRIM(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.mcp_server,'^(mcp__codex_apps__|plugin:[^:]+:|claude\\.ai |claude_ai_|mcp__)',''),'-server',''))) END AS server,
         e.tool, e.session, COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) AS person,
         COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') AS team, e.observed_at, DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1e9)) DAY) AS w
  FROM whodunit_events e LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = e.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND e.tool <> '' AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')),
s AS (SELECT server, COUNT(DISTINCT person) people, COUNT(*) calls FROM c
      WHERE server <> '' AND person IS NOT NULL GROUP BY server)
SELECT people AS `people using it`, ROUND(calls/people,0) AS `calls per person`, server FROM s

panels.title: Server profile
panels.description: Per server: when it was first called, how many people and teams use it, total calls, and calls per session. Calls per session is the depth figure — an integration called once a session is a lookup; one called twenty times is a workflow.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN e.mcp_server IS NULL OR e.mcp_server = '' THEN '' ELSE LOWER(TRIM(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.mcp_server,'^(mcp__codex_apps__|plugin:[^:]+:|claude\\.ai |claude_ai_|mcp__)',''),'-server',''))) END AS server,
         e.tool, e.session, COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) AS person,
         COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') AS team, e.observed_at, DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1e9)) DAY) AS w
  FROM whodunit_events e LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = e.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND e.tool <> '' AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')),
s AS (SELECT server, COUNT(DISTINCT person) people, COUNT(DISTINCT team) teams, COUNT(*) calls,
             COUNT(DISTINCT session) sessions,
             MIN(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(observed_at/1e9))) first_used
      FROM c WHERE server <> '' GROUP BY server)
SELECT server AS `Server`, DATE_FORMAT(first_used,'%b %e') AS `First used`,
       people AS `People`, teams AS `Teams`, calls AS `Calls`,
       ROUND(calls/NULLIF(sessions,0),1) AS `Calls per session`
FROM s ORDER BY calls DESC

panels.title: Which integrations each team leans on
panels.description: Share of a team's MCP calls going to each of the six busiest servers. Read across a row: a team split evenly is exploring; one at 60% on a single server has built a workflow around it. Blank means the team has not called that server in range.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN e.mcp_server IS NULL OR e.mcp_server = '' THEN '' ELSE LOWER(TRIM(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.mcp_server,'^(mcp__codex_apps__|plugin:[^:]+:|claude\\.ai |claude_ai_|mcp__)',''),'-server',''))) END AS server,
         e.tool, e.session, COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) AS person,
         COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') AS team, e.observed_at, DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1e9)) DAY) AS w
  FROM whodunit_events e LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = e.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND e.tool <> '' AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')),
t AS (SELECT team, server, COUNT(*) n FROM c WHERE server <> '' GROUP BY team, server),
tot AS (SELECT team, SUM(n) total FROM t GROUP BY team),
top AS (SELECT server FROM t GROUP BY server ORDER BY SUM(n) DESC LIMIT 6)
SELECT t.team AS `Team`, t.server AS `Server`, ROUND(100*t.n/tot.total,0) AS `share`
FROM t JOIN tot ON tot.team = t.team JOIN top ON top.server = t.server
ORDER BY t.team, t.server

panels.title: Not using integrations yet
panels.description: People with agent tool calls in range and none of them to an MCP server, most active first. They are using the agent; they are not using its integrations. The list to act on when a server has been rolled out and is not being picked up.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN e.mcp_server IS NULL OR e.mcp_server = '' THEN '' ELSE LOWER(TRIM(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.mcp_server,'^(mcp__codex_apps__|plugin:[^:]+:|claude\\.ai |claude_ai_|mcp__)',''),'-server',''))) END AS server,
         e.tool, e.session, COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) AS person,
         COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') AS team, e.observed_at, DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1e9)) DAY) AS w
  FROM whodunit_events e LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = e.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND e.tool <> '' AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}'))
SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(person,'@',1) AS `Person`, team AS `Team`,
       COUNT(*) AS `Tool calls`, COUNT(DISTINCT session) AS `Sessions`
FROM c WHERE person IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY person, team HAVING SUM(server <> '') = 0
ORDER BY `Tool calls` DESC

panels.title: MCP against built-in, share of calls per week
panels.description: Every tool call each week, split between integrations and built-in tools, as shares that sum to 100. A rising MCP band means integrations are displacing built-in tools, which is what a working rollout looks like.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN e.mcp_server IS NULL OR e.mcp_server = '' THEN '' ELSE LOWER(TRIM(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.mcp_server,'^(mcp__codex_apps__|plugin:[^:]+:|claude\\.ai |claude_ai_|mcp__)',''),'-server',''))) END AS server,
         e.tool, e.session, COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) AS person,
         COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') AS team, e.observed_at, DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1e9)) DAY) AS w
  FROM whodunit_events e LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = e.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND e.tool <> '' AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}'))
SELECT CAST(w AS DATETIME) AS time,
       SUM(server <> '') AS `MCP`,
       SUM(server = '') AS `Built-in`
FROM c GROUP BY w ORDER BY time

panels.title: The six busiest servers, per week
panels.description: Weekly calls for the six most-used servers, one line each. Which integrations are growing, which have plateaued, and whether a new one is displacing an old one.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN e.mcp_server IS NULL OR e.mcp_server = '' THEN '' ELSE LOWER(TRIM(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.mcp_server,'^(mcp__codex_apps__|plugin:[^:]+:|claude\\.ai |claude_ai_|mcp__)',''),'-server',''))) END AS server,
         e.tool, e.session, COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) AS person,
         COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') AS team, e.observed_at, DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1e9)) DAY) AS w
  FROM whodunit_events e LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = e.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND e.tool <> '' AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')),
top AS (SELECT server FROM c WHERE server <> '' GROUP BY server ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 6)
SELECT CAST(c.w AS DATETIME) AS time, c.server AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value
FROM c JOIN top ON top.server = c.server GROUP BY c.w, c.server ORDER BY time, c.server

panels.title: How many sessions reach for one, and how hard
panels.description: Two lines. Share of sessions each week that made at least one MCP call (breadth), and among those, the average number of MCP calls (depth). Breadth rising with depth flat is people trying it; both rising is people relying on it.

targets.rawSql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN e.mcp_server IS NULL OR e.mcp_server = '' THEN '' ELSE LOWER(TRIM(REPLACE(REGEXP_REPLACE(e.mcp_server,'^(mcp__codex_apps__|plugin:[^:]+:|claude\\.ai |claude_ai_|mcp__)',''),'-server',''))) END AS server,
         e.tool, e.session, COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) AS person,
         COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') AS team, e.observed_at, DATE_SUB(DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1e9)), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(e.observed_at/1e9)) DAY) AS w
  FROM whodunit_events e LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = e.contributor
    LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor)
    LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
  WHERE e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom()*1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo()*1000000000 AND e.tool <> '' AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
    AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name,'(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')),
s AS (SELECT w, session, SUM(server <> '') mcp FROM c GROUP BY w, session)
SELECT CAST(w AS DATETIME) AS time,
       ROUND(100*SUM(mcp > 0)/COUNT(*),0) AS `Sessions using an integration`,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN mcp > 0 THEN mcp END),1) AS `MCP calls, when used`
FROM s GROUP BY w ORDER BY time

panels.title: Tools called most, within MCP
panels.description: The individual tool behind each call, not just the server. This is the granularity that answers whether an integration is used for the thing it was bought for — a Jira MCP called only to read issues is a different purchase from one used to file and transition them.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(e.tool, '__', -1), '_', ' ') AS `tool`,
       COUNT(*) AS `calls`
FROM whodunit_events e
LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = e.contributor
LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor)
LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
WHERE e.tool LIKE 'mcp\\_\\_%' AND e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
  AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__'
       OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
GROUP BY REPLACE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(e.tool, '__', -1), '_', ' ')
ORDER BY `calls` DESC
LIMIT 12

panels.title: Built-in tools, for comparison
panels.description: The tools agents reach for without an integration. Shown beside the MCP panels because the ratio is the useful part: MCP calls are a small share of a much larger volume of ordinary editing, and a dashboard showing only MCP would imply otherwise.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.tool AS `tool`, COUNT(*) AS `calls`
FROM whodunit_events e
LEFT JOIN whodunit_identities wi ON wi.alias = e.contributor
LEFT JOIN team_users tu ON tu.user_id = COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor)
LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = tu.team_id
WHERE e.tool NOT LIKE 'mcp\\_\\_%' AND e.tool <> '' AND e.observed_at BETWEEN $__unixEpochFrom() * 1000000000 AND $__unixEpochTo() * 1000000000
  AND ('${team:raw}' = '__all__' OR COALESCE(t.name, '(unassigned)') = '${team:raw}')
  AND ('${contributor:raw}' = '__all__'
       OR COALESCE(wi.canonical, e.contributor) = '${contributor:raw}')
GROUP BY e.tool
ORDER BY `calls` DESC
LIMIT 10

options.content: Not on this page. MCP calls carry no outcome, so there is no per-server failure or success rate — that would need the agent to report one. Server names are normalised across agents (a plugin prefix and a -server suffix are stripped), so the same integration reached through two agents counts once. A person on the not-started list may use integrations through an agent that does not record them; the list says who, not why.
